channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Excess RNA can starve cells of energy, study finds
item.description: Scientists have found that too much RNA can damage the structures cells use to produce energy, an unexpected internal danger.

item.title: Solar storm train delay mystery solved after 178 years
item.description: Scientists have solved a 178-year-old mystery about a train delayed by a solar storm, finding the famous incident occurred in 1848 rather than as previously thought.

item.title: Astronaut Hearts Pass Surprising Test for Mars Missions
item.description: A study of 13 astronauts indicates the human heart may be well suited for a Mars journey, particularly with regular exercise.

item.title: Scientists Reverse 60 Years of Aging in Human Cells
item.description: Researchers converted blood cells from an 80-year-old into neural stem cells with a molecular age under 20, reversing over 60 years of aging.
